title: Gravship construction and flight prerequisites
summary: A pilot console alone is not a flight-capable gravship; inspect connected substructure and the engine.
body: A gravship carries structures on supported substructure connected to its grav engine. The minimum flight components include the engine, connected substructure, a thruster, a chemfuel tank and a pilot console. Build and inspect the foundation before planning rooms. The wiki identifies range and supported-area limits; query the current engine and placement interface instead of assuming a design fits. Orbital travel additionally requires protection from vacuum. This record describes prerequisites, not a launch authorization or a victory condition.

sources.supports: Connected structure, minimum flight parts and vacuum preparation
sources.authority: Community wiki; check current game UI for consequential details
